items.name: Homemade chicken meatballs (veg-loaded)
items.recipe: 1 kg ground chicken; 1 large onion (chopped, fried); grated sweet potato; grated zucchini/courgette; salt, pepper; a little ketchup; 2 eggs; ~½ cup breadcrumbs. Rest ~1h in fridge, spoon onto pan, fry on medium heat.
items.source: Estimated from recipe; ~2,250 kcal total over ~1,275 g cooked yield → ~176 kcal/100 g. Refine if you weigh the cooked batch.
